rubric: Fixed blocks placed first with real clock times; wishes placed with their hours or named as not fitting with the hours missing.
Buffers kept: 15 minutes between blocks, one free evening, one free half day; no more than 2 planned hours after a full work day.
A table by time and day that reads in one glance, cells of 2 to 4 words; three rules for the week.
A to-do list is sorted into today (max 3), this week, later, with time slots for today and the first thing to do now.
No wishes added that the user did not name; children's or partner's hours never guessed.

prompts.text: Plan my week: work Mon-Fri 8:30-17:00, 30 min commute, I want to run 3 times, cook dinner at home most days, study for a certificate 4 hours, and see my parents on the weekend.
Ich bin alleinerziehend, Kind in der Schule 8-15 Uhr, ich arbeite 25 Stunden flexibel von zu Hause. Wie lege ich die Arbeit, den Haushalt und Zeit für mich in die Woche?
عندي امتحانات بعد 3 أسابيع وأعمل 4 ساعات يوميًا مساءً. رتب لي جدولًا يوميًا للمذاكرة والنوم والرياضة.

Here's my to-do list, I'm overwhelmed: call the dentist, finish the tax return (due Friday), buy a birthday present for Sam (party Saturday), fix the bike, reply to 12 emails, book the car service, write the report for Monday, clean the kitchen. What do I do first?
Mach mir einen Tagesplan für morgen: Zahnarzt 10:30, Meeting 14-15 Uhr, 2 Stunden konzentriert am Projekt, Sport, Einkaufen, und ich will um 22 Uhr im Bett sein.
I keep planning to write my novel and never do. I have evenings free Mon, Wed, Thu and Sunday mornings. Make me a realistic writing schedule.
